blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No ticket holder won the ₱259.92-million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the ₱90.14 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Saturday, Oct. 10, 2026. According to the PCSO results provided, the Grand Lotto 6/55 draw produced the winning combination 41-04-23-09-39-54, with a jackpot prize of ₱259.92 million. No bettor matched all six numbers. The Lotto 6/42 draw yielded the winning combination 29-05-16-19-14-25 for a jackpot of ₱90.14 million. No ticket holder won the top prize.
